question: By whose grace does the speaker come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine?
premises: The speaker addresses the Lord of the Kaulas.
It is by the Lord's grace that knowledge arises.
Through that grace, the speaker has come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
inference: By the grace of the Lord of the Kaulas, the speaker has come to know the Kaula determination.
uncertainties: The extent of that knowledge is not specified in this verse.
plain_english: By your grace, O Lord of the Kaulas, I have come to know the determination of the Kaula doctrine.
